author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
A non-AI native colleague calls my very details AI generated email reply answering his question a spam.

I marked it clearly the email is generated by AI on the first line, why he still chooses to read an AI generated email with his human eyes, then accuse me wasting his time? 

Why can't he simply ask AI to read all his emails.   My AI email does have the answer he is looking for.  What does he expect from me?   Should I type him a reply with my own hands?   THAT is a waste of my time.

comments.text: I truly cannot tell if this is sarcasm or meant at face value.
